findings.title: Username/email enumeration via timing attack
findings.description: The uniqueness checks in updateFullProfile query the database and return 400 immediately when a match is found. An attacker with valid credentials can enumerate existing usernames or emails by measuring response times.
findings.recommendation: Add constant-time comparison or rate limiting.

findings.title: Phone number stored with country code prefix
findings.description: The Android app concatenates selectedCountry.dialCode + localNumber and stores the result in the phone field. Backend queries by phone number require substring matching, and validation via libphonenumber will fail.
findings.recommendation: Store country code and local number in separate fields or normalize to E.164 on write.

findings.title: No validation on dateOfBirth format
findings.description: The Android app sends dateOfBirth as a display string ("02 / 03 / 2024"). The backend stores it as-is without parsing or validation. Backend queries by age or date range will fail.
findings.recommendation: Store dates as ISO 8601 strings or Date objects.

findings.title: Missing authentication on wishlist routes
findings.description: The wishlist controller uses :id path params for user identification without protectRoute. Any client can add/remove products from any user's wishlist by guessing user IDs. (Out of scope for this review, but high-severity.)
findings.recommendation: Add protectRoute middleware and derive userId from req.user._id, not from the URL.
